full_judgment: 4. The aforesaid submission of the learned Assistant Attorney General also finds support in the case of Md Ali Bhuiya and another Vs Idrish Ali Bhuiya and another reported in 21 DLR page No.910 where it is held that in view of the fact and circumstances of the case it can be said that the Mistake or oversight of Tadbirkar in obtaining Information about copy of judgment is a sufficient cause within the meaning of section 5 of the Limitation Act and the petitioners are entitled to have an extension of time. The delay in presenting the appeal should, therefore, be condoned.
